LICENSE & PROVENANCE POLICY v0.1

1. A public Git repository is not automatically safe to copy into EDEN.
2. Record project, repository URL, exact commit/tag, retrieved date, license file and relevant subcomponent license before code/design reuse.
3. Distinguish: inspiration/reference; API/protocol interoperability; dependency; modified source; copied design; redistributed binary; copied documentation/media.
4. Preserve notices/attribution where required.
5. Do not mix incompatible licensing obligations into edenOS Core without explicit review.
6. Mechanical/CAD/PCB/media licenses may differ from software licenses in the same project.
7. OpenMower specifically requires component-level review because its ecosystem contains multiple repositories/materials and licensing conditions.
8. Before public/commercial distribution, run a fresh dependency/license audit.

PROVENANCE RECORD FIELDS
Name | URL | repository | commit/tag | date | license | artifact type | intended EDEN use | modifications | attribution | redistribution status | reviewer.
